summary: Large tire-physics state initializer. Runs a 45-iteration StructZeroInit_6f00 loop over a stride-32-dword sub-struct array, zero-inits two sub-structs via StructZeroInit_6bc0, then zeroes the leading scalar fields, an array of twelve dword slots, and trailing fields, setting the float at offset 0xA0 to 1.0f. Returns this. Invoked by PhysicsTireSystemConstructor (004E4500).
